The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is equiped in the {{Icon|sword}} slot and deals damage to enemies in front of the player when used. It deals {{Health|-|10}} damage to enemies, making it a significant upgrade over the [[rusty sword]], and can either be crafted at a [[anvil|metal anvil]] or purchased from [[Koukol]] near the [[mountain fort]]. Alternatively, as the required technology is found on a relatively insignificant 'branch', one may easily bypass it in favor of it's successor - the [[steel sword]].
